title: Performance budget enforced on production builds
asA: user on a mid-range phone and a slow connection
iWant: the application usable within seconds of opening it
soThat: performance is a shipped property, not a lab number

acceptanceCriteria.description: First meaningful paint lands under 2 seconds on the 3G-fast reference profile against a production build of every declared key route.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a production build under the 3G-fast profile
acceptanceCriteria.then: first meaningful paint is under 2 seconds

acceptanceCriteria.description: Lighthouse performance scores 90 or above on every declared key route against a production build.
Total main-thread work during initial load stays under 3 seconds per key route.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a production build profiled on load
acceptanceCriteria.then: the total is under 3 seconds per route

acceptanceCriteria.description: Route-level code splitting keeps any single route's initial JavaScript payload within the budget declared in the project; no route loads the whole application to render itself.
acceptanceCriteria.then: each route loads only its declared chunks within budget
